relationships.subject: Tetrahydropalmatine
relationships.evidence_quote: THP exerted its actions by suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome activation and subsequent formation of caspase-1.

relationships.subject: Tetrahydropalmatine
relationships.evidence_quote: THP alleviated MSU-induced reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, upstream of NLRP3 inflammasome activation, by an increase in the activities of antioxidant enzymes both in vitro and in vivo

relationships.subject: Tetrahydropalmatine
relationships.evidence_quote: THP attenuated pain and swelling in an MSU-induced acute gout model by decreasing pro-inflammatory cytokine production and inflammatory cell infiltration

key_findings: THP attenuates MSU-induced gout pain and swelling by suppressing ROS-mediated NLRP3 inflammasome activation
